title: Evaluate a manufactured triple-product counter without scanning the field
statement: At b=3,s=1, acquire independent factors of the homogeneous field cubic, normalize the quadratic terms, and reduce each Walsh leaf to a Kloosterman sum evaluated by a finite Dwork matrix trace modulo2^N with centered integer reconstruction.

requires: d>=3 and a verified product of three independent field-linear forms
provides: At b=3,s=1, acquire independent factors of the homogeneous field cubic, normalize the quadratic terms, and reduce each Walsh leaf to a Kloosterman sum evaluated by a finite Dwork matrix trace modulo2^N with centered integer reconstruction.
assumptions: General multivariate point counting is outside this implemented backend
Trace aliases at d=1,2 reject the factor uniqueness argument
costs: Seven-probe factor searches, polynomial field arithmetic; matrices8N-1 over the unramified ring
PrecisionN=d+2 suffices by elementary magnitude bound; optional Hasse precision is narrower
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: A full2^d field scan is unnecessary for this specific complete counter.

body: Saved21/24-bit exhaustive comparisons and30/36-bit Dwork counts are original evidence. The96-bit example has defect rank zero. Intake did not execute them.
